material_findings.finding: Rechecking the complete current bank surfaced unasked defensive-deployment timing/optionality. Q28’s key cannot substitute for its question’s request for origin only.
The reset of all Combat markers to zero after rewards also appears only as incidental Q08 key background; no current question asks the marker-reset procedure.

new_questions.question: At what precise event can a human who already controls a location deploy its defensive troop, is taking that defensive bonus optional, and does it require an Agent visit to the location? After all Combat rewards, what must happen to all Combat markers before the next phase?
new_questions.expected_answer: When a Conflict card is revealed for a location the human already controls, the controller may immediately deploy one troop from their supply directly to the Conflict. The bonus is optional, needs no Agent visit, and is available at Conflict reveal during Round Start, before that round’s hands are drawn. Once all Combat rewards have been given, reset all Combat markers to zero during Combat cleanup, alongside returning troops to supply and sandworms to the bank; do not wait for Recall.
new_questions.source_references: Main PDF p10 Critical Locations and the Shield Wall, p8 Round Start, p14 Resolve Combat; run main extraction lines571–573,397–406,842–843. Supplements PDF p5 lines324–325 confirms the same reveal trigger for Rival defense.
new_questions.novelty: Two distinct source-defined Combat-boundary procedures: defensive deployment’s trigger/optionality and post-Combat marker reset. Q28 explicitly asks only the defensive troop’s origin; its reveal timing and permission appear only in its key. Q70 asks whether a Rival can gain defense, not human timing/optionality. Q08 asks pass closure and troop/worm destinations; marker reset is unasked key background. Q71 asks setting strength during Reveal, not clearing markers after rewards. This tests new procedures rather than another location/quantity variant.
